snippet.title: KEEP IT ON HER — Gameplay Trailer: Earlier...
snippet.description:
One shift at Sweetie's Motel, from the first call of the morning to the night the power goes out. Fetch the towels and mop up after the guests. At night, keep your flashlight on Sweetie.

Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5300960/KEEP_IT_ON_HER/

Horror for 1-4 players, solo or in online co-op, on Windows, macOS and Linux.
